desc: Prove structure of optimal sequences: all down-flips before up-flips (exchange argument), downs sorted desc by C, ups sorted asc; optional 1→1 indices used as down-then-up pairs; 0→0 indices never used; extra flip pairs never help.
Derive total cost formula: Total = PairsMin(downset) + PairsMin(upset) + Σ_{upset} C + Σ_{inactive optionals} C·m, and verify on examples (103/201 case, Sample 1 → 16, Sample 2 → 0).
Prove prefix optimality: activating optionals in descending C order is optimal (swap argument showing Δ ≤ −(C_j−C_i) < 0 when activating smaller while larger inactive).
Derive incremental Δ_t formula for adding t-th optional: Δ = c·(cntGE_DR(c)+t−1) + sumLT_DR(c) + c·(cntGE_UR(c)+t−1) + sumLT_UR(c) + c + 2·suffix_{t+1} − c·m_{t−1}.
Implement solve() in Python with fast I/O: parse input, build DR/UR/OP lists, sort + prefix sums, compute Total(0), iterate prefixes tracking min, print answer.
Final review of code for correctness (tie handling via bisect_left, 64-bit-safe arithmetic via Python ints, edge cases: empty DR/UR/OP, N=1) and complexity O(N log N).
